question.text: Expenses incurred by a Cat III AIF (Management Fees, Performance Fees, fund expenses) in computing capital gains on fund units:

answer.text: Are disallowed per Section 14A (no deduction for expenses related to income not forming part of the fund's total income)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.6, Section 14A disallows expenses related to income not forming part of the fund's total income (e.g., capital gains taxed at investor level). **The Trap:** Other treatments don't match Section 14A. **Cross-Exam Context:** Critical for investor net-return computation. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** This Section 14A drag is often missed in after-tax IRR projections.
